summary: Refresh the current transition-state gate after the seven-job held-out VASP batch completed and the review-only 19-image path rebuild was prepared.

payload.title: Active Gate - 2026-08-27 Held-Out Validation Complete and Path Rebuild Awaiting Review
facts: Held-out VASP jobs `9731537`-`9731543` are `DONE`; all seven passed normal-completion, electronic-convergence, exact-structure, complete-force, magnetic-evidence, `SIGMA=0.20 eV`, and remote/local hash gates.

On six primary disjoint structures, frozen MatRIS passed the current ceilings with force-vector RMSE `0.113936 eV/A`, maximum force-vector error `0.388424 eV/A`, and relative-energy RMSE `0.087345 eV`.
AQCat25 reached force-vector RMSE `0.125709 eV/A` but failed the relative-energy ceiling at `0.133379 eV`; it remains an exact-path force/geometry auditor, not the TS-path energy-ranking authority.
No MatRIS fine-tuning is required by this held-out gate, and quantitative uncertainty remains uncalibrated because no real MatRIS committee exists.

A local review-only 19-image complete-path rebuild passed the recorded seed geometry checks; no remote preflight, upload, GPU/VASP/VTST submission, Dimer, TS, or barrier action has occurred for this package.
The seven completed VASP jobs are recorded evidence from the finished held-out batch; the current authorization boundary applies only to additional submissions.
payload.next_action: Review the exact 19-image seed and request; if accepted, run only the hash-bound MZ73 environment/checkpoint/runtime preflight, then request separate authorization before any submission.
